newsitem.title: USA: Storm threatens shipping in Coral Sea - WSC.
newsitem.headline: Storm threatens shipping in Coral Sea - WSC.

text.p: Tropical Cyclone Drena, with top winds near 140 mph, is a threat to shipping in the eastern Coral Sea, private forecaster Weather Services Corporation (WSC) said on Monday.
The storm is centred near 17s/159e and is moving southwest at 4 mph.
A turn to the south is expected while the storm begins to weaken slowly.
By 48 hours, it should be west of New Caledonia.
